about_the_game:
Welcome to the urban jungle with the GameGuru MAX Modern Day Asset Graffiti pack - add some grime to your levels!

This pack, our 3rd collaboration with talented artist Melburnian, is Ideal for a wide range of games from post apocalyptic, through modern day and into the dystopian and cyberpunk genres. The pack contains 4 complete stylized alphabets and an additional stenciled alphabet, all complete with punctuation and numeric symbols.

As well as the above, you'll find 16 spray paint styled symbols, ranging from bio hazard through to resistance signs - perfect for adding extra detail.

Create your own tags and warnings, or use to engage in environmental storytelling. You can even change the colour of your graffiti in the GameGuru MAX level editor.

Coming in at a total of more than 210 high quality decal style models, the Modern Day Asset Graffiti pack is ideal for all urban game makers!
